record.hypothesis: The lab driver uses the installed libaom SVC API to author a real 160×96, 120-frame, 60 fps AV1 sequence with one spatial layer and three temporal layers. Actual frame OBU counts were 30 at temporal ID 0, 30 at ID 1, and 60 at ID 2. The encoder produced operating-point masks 0x107, 0x103 and 0x101. A fixture-scoped parser extracts temporal ID 0, retains its coded frame OBUs, and rewrites the sequence header to advertise one available operating point. The IVF timing is changed from 60 ticks/second with every fourth picture retained to 15 ticks/second with sequential picture indices; presentation timestamps remain the same. The picture payload is not decoded and re-encoded by the extractor. This is not a general-purpose parser for arbitrary AV1 headers.
